skills.name: koala-core
skills.title: Koala operating contract and router
skills.description: Use when a request broadly involves Koala MCP, several Koala workflows, budgeted agent loops, or shared safety and evidence rules.

skills.name: koala-connect
skills.title: Connection and capability preflight
skills.description: Use when connecting Koala MCP, diagnosing missing Koala tools, choosing capability permissions, or checking whether a host can use the server.

skills.name: koala-budget
skills.title: Credit and Writer allowance planner
skills.description: Use when estimating Koala research costs, checking remaining allowances, allocating a batch budget, or limiting a repeatable marketing agent run.

skills.name: koala-brand-audit
skills.title: Brand context and knowledge audit
skills.description: Use when auditing Brand DNA, improving brand documentation, checking writing defaults, or preventing facts and voice from leaking between clients.

skills.name: koala-opportunity-research
skills.title: Research worthwhile content opportunities
skills.description: Use when choosing topics, finding keyword opportunities, avoiding cannibalization, or deciding between refreshing a page and creating new content.

skills.name: koala-content-plan
skills.title: Evidence-backed editorial calendar proposal
skills.description: Use when planning the next content batch, deciding what to publish over a period, or turning an opportunity shortlist into an editorial calendar without executing it.

skills.name: koala-content-decay
skills.title: First-party content decay investigation
skills.description: Use when pages lose clicks or impressions, rankings stall, or a publisher asks what declined over a comparable reporting period.

skills.name: koala-competitor-analysis
skills.title: Competitor advantage and gap analysis
skills.description: Use when comparing a domain with search competitors, explaining a competitor’s advantage, or prioritizing keyword and backlink gaps.

skills.name: koala-article-production
skills.title: Approved brief to verified Koala article
skills.description: Use when the user explicitly requests a complete KoalaWriter article from an approved topic or brief, not when merely researching or planning content.

skills.name: koala-page-refresh
skills.title: Existing-page rescue and refresh brief
skills.description: Use when improving an existing URL, rescuing a page near page one, correcting stale content, or refreshing a page without creating a competing URL.

skills.name: koala-editorial-qa
skills.title: Evidence-first editorial acceptance loop
skills.description: Use when reviewing a Koala article, checking factual/brand quality, applying bounded editorial feedback, or deciding whether a draft is ready for human publication review.

skills.name: koala-queue-operations
skills.title: Queue recovery and safe resumption
skills.description: Use when Koala writing appears stuck, an article ID was lost, a connection ended while generating, or duplicate jobs may have been queued.

skills.name: koala-calendar-operations
skills.title: Approved scheduling, rescheduling and cancellation
skills.description: Use when the user explicitly authorizes adding, changing or cancelling Koala scheduled article tasks, including resolving a partial batch result.

skills.name: koala-onpage-audit
skills.title: Evidence-first on-page audit
skills.description: Use when a public webpage needs an on-page, canonical, metadata, schema or visible-layout audit without changing the site.

skills.name: koala-internal-links
skills.title: Internal-link opportunity map
skills.description: Use when finding relevant internal links, mapping topic clusters, or proposing links to support an existing article.

skills.name: koala-ai-visibility
skills.title: Sampled Google AI Overview visibility
skills.description: Use when checking Google AI Overview citations, citation readiness, AI-crawler declarations, or competitor citation gaps.

skills.name: koala-link-prospecting
skills.title: Qualified backlink prospecting
skills.description: Use when researching referring domains, lost or broken links, backlink gaps, anchor patterns, or a manual outreach shortlist.

skills.name: koala-prospect-audit
skills.title: Public-domain prospect audit
skills.description: Use when evaluating an agency prospect, acquisition lead or unfamiliar domain using public search and page evidence.

skills.name: koala-affiliate-research
skills.title: Evidence-backed affiliate product research
skills.description: Use when researching an Amazon roundup, product comparison or single-product article with accurate product identity and attributed evidence.

skills.name: koala-seasonal-content
skills.title: Seasonal demand and publishing lead time
skills.description: Use when planning seasonal topics, comparing Google and Pinterest trends, or choosing when to refresh and publish ahead of demand.

skills.name: koala-video-to-article
skills.title: Rights-aware video-to-article preparation
skills.description: Use when turning a supplied YouTube video into an article or researching video evidence for a content brief.

skills.name: koala-image-briefs
skills.title: Approved image briefs and generation
skills.description: Use when preparing or generating KoalaImages assets for a social post, Pinterest pin, advertisement or supporting illustration.

skills.name: koala-performance-review
skills.title: Measured performance and experiment review
skills.description: Use when evaluating content changes with connected Search Console and Analytics, comparing periods, or checking whether an intervention helped.

skills.name: koala-portfolio-loop
skills.title: Bounded multi-brand content operations loop
skills.description: Use when coordinating several brands or repeating evidence-to-action content workflows across a portfolio with shared account budgets.

skills.name: koala-schema-watch
skills.title: Beta contract and capability drift review
skills.description: Use when Koala tools appear changed, an argument stops working, a beta update arrives, or the tool catalogue needs verification.

skills.name: koala-indexing
skills.title: Verified URL indexing inspection and submission
skills.description: Use when inspecting Google indexing state or when the user explicitly requests submission of specific URLs on a connected property.
